scope: Independent static review of root actual audit script/results and direct viewing of 16 original Night/Penguin PNGs. No repeat native run, no rerun of 1177 unique source checks, no package download/copy.

auditReview.note: This is supplemental review of the actual frozen original-export audit; it does not rerun source/native checks or independently recreate the producer API verification. 1429 per-game input references correspond to 1177 unique source files.

visualFindings: No main action/ID clipping or side-card obstruction of pause buttons in the 16 viewed images.
Night 960x540 main menu requires vertical scrolling for lower keyboard-help content; primary choices and Start race remain visible.
Penguin expanded paused/reconnected card covers part of the inactive background minimap; pause actions and ID remain readable.
Minimum-window captures are preconnection menu screenshots, not connected-ID coverage at 960x540. Connected ID coverage here is from the 1280x720 playing/paused/reconnected PNGs.

screenshots.observation: Actually viewed: 960x540 menu shows Neon District map choices, race mode, difficulty/class, Start race, Garage and Settings. Host card left is readable with no connected ID yet. Vertical scrollbar is present; lower keyboard-help rows extend below the viewport and are partly under the footer. Main choices/start remain visible.

Actually viewed: night city circuit, red player car and opponents, lap/position/timer, map and speed HUD are rendered. Left controller icon, 1P connected and complete wrapped ID are visible without covering the car or race HUD. Speed is 0 in this still; this image alone is not evidence of vehicle motion.
